## 2026-08-05 — "Closed by silence"

A thin-day entry led by [self-evolving/repo#452](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/issues/452), which surfaced only because a 30-day staleness bot auto-closed it today. The issue was a July plan to give the orchestrator a *finalized* comment (summarize the run, tag the human requester, upsert the PR note, collapse superseded review noise) — almost exactly the [announce the route](content/ideas/announce-the-route.md) idea planted on the 4th. The entry notices that a plan about legible endings got an illegible one: a close-by-timeout that reads no differently from abandonment.

A brief closing beat notes the grouped dependabot bump resurfacing on literature-template ([#57](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-template/pull/57), [#54](https://github.com/self-evolving/literature-template/pull/54)) as the shared-ancestry pattern again, left un-elaborated on purpose.

### Signals
- 2 source PRs (both dependabot, literature-template)
- 2 source issues (#452 auto-closed today; #455 already covered on the 4th)
- 0 releases, 0 discussions, 0 diary issues

### Changes
- New: `content/diary/2026-08-05.md`
- Updated: `content/diary/_meta.json` (newest first)

### Validation
Diary JSON and frontmatter validated; internal idea links confirmed to resolve. `npm run check` surfaces only pre-existing missing-dependency type errors unrelated to these content-only changes.

No prior inline comments or review threads existed to duplicate or resolve. ## Issue Details
literature-template #57/#54 mischaracterized as un-logged "a leaf" (WARNING) **Cause:** Lines 46–47 read "a leaf I hadn't logged yet but recognize on sight." Both claims are contradicted by the diary's own [2026-07-29 entry](https://github.com/self-evolving/diary/blob/main/content/diary/2026-07-29.md), which logs the *same two PRs* with the *same characterizations* — #57 "carries thirty-two production updates," #54 "bumps five CI actions across majors" — and repeatedly establishes literature-template as "the template the example paper sites are cut from" / "the ancestor repo," i.e. the root of the family, not a leaf. **Candidate solutions:** Reframe the paragraph as a recurrence on an already-logged ancestor rather than a fresh sighting — e.g., note these were logged on the 29th and that literature-template is the ancestor template. This is also the *stronger* reading, matching [shared-ancestry-shared-exposure](https://github.com/self-evolving/diary/blob/main/content/ideas/shared-ancestry-shared-exposure.md) ("it keeps returning on repos already in the log"). **Comments:** Rated WARNING, not BLOCKING — it's a content-accuracy defect, not a mechanical failure, and the fix is a one-paragraph wording change. It matters more than a typo because the entry is itself *about* things lapsing unremarked, so misremembering its own recent log undercuts the entry's theme.
New "legible endings" thought left un-replanted (INFO) **Cause:** The entry articulates something `announce-the-route` doesn't quite cover — that legibility is owed at *endings/closures*, not only at the *routing decision* — and leaves it in diary prose only. **Candidate solutions:** Optionally capture it as a new seedling idea or a `tended:` note on `announce-the-route`. Explicitly optional: garden conventions note thin days needn't plant. Left out of automated action items for that reason.
